newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KOLOSUS FALLS AFTER WEAK YEAR FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: KOLOSUS FALLS AFTER WEAK YEAR FIGURES.

text.p: Shares in South African foods firm Kolosus Holdings Ltd slipped on Thursday after the company reported a slide in results for the 12 months ended May 31, dealers said.

By about 0815 GMT Kolosus was down 40 cents or 11.6 percent at 300 cents, making it the second biggest percentage loser on the Johannesburg bourse in early trade. Some 70,800 shares worth around 221,920 rand had changed hands.
"They've come out with very bad results and I think that's why the share has gone down. They were not what the market expected them to be," one dealer said.

Results released earlier show Kolosus' earnings per share on net operating income down at 30.48 cents from 70.33 cents a year ago, while on net income earnings per share fell to 12.61 cents from 23.33 cents previously.
The firm did not declare a dividend and added that its financial year-end would be changed to Septemeber 30.
